title: Delete a record where the button is located
goal: Use closest to find the relevant record node, and then use remove to delete the node.
summary: Each item in the equipment borrowing list has its own remove button. Clicking the text or button shell only deletes the current line.
tasks: Add click monitoring to #rows and handle it only when the click comes from the .remove button.
Find the nearest li to which the button belongs and delete it. Keep other records with the list itself.

example.note: closest searches for the first matching element upwards from the target element itself.

hint: first locates the button that may be clicked, and then locates the list item from the button.
